title: spec(lint): the view publish door accepts a chart list view whose dataset does not exist or whose `values` names no measure of its dataset
body:
Filing gate: class (a), a reachable defect. Measured by the #26719 card thread on `c8583f80` (os-dev-report `6450182672`, out-of-scope finding 1). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017, session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What was measured

- `PUT /api/v1/meta/view` publishes a chart list view and answers `200` in two cases: its `chart.dataset` names no declared dataset (`no_such_dataset`), or its `chart.values` names no measure of that dataset (`ghost_measure`). Both were measured as a view item and as a container `listViews` member.
- `os validate` does report the same stack. `validateChartBindings` (`packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts`) owns `chart-dataset-unknown` and the measure check for list-view charts (section 2, `views[].list`, `views[].listViews.KEY`, `objects[].listViews.KEY`).
- The publish door never runs it for a view. `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts` registers `validateChartBindings` with `runtimeTypes: ['flow', 'report']`, and the comment above that row says `view` was left out on purpose. Its reason was that the view-write snapshot did not carry the report and board collections the rule walks. A list-view chart resolves only against `stack.datasets`, which `runtime-gate.ts` lists as context.
- `validateChartBindings` walks `views[].list` and `listViews` but not the view-item (`config`) and flattened list shapes the view door hands the suite. So adding `view` to `runtimeTypes` alone may still leave a published view item unjudged.

Re-check: `grep -n "name: 'validateChartBindings'" packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`. While the row reads `['flow', 'report']`, the gap is open.

## Wanted

A chart list view whose dataset does not resolve, or whose `values` names no measure of its dataset, is refused at the view publish door (`422`, located at `chart.dataset` or `chart.values[i]`), with the same verdicts `os validate` already gives. That means:
- the rule reaches the shapes the view door carries, and
- `view` (and `object`, for `objects[].listViews`) joins its `runtimeTypes`.

This is a refusal widening, so measure the shipped view corpus at the door's snapshot shape before crossing, as #19542 did for `report`. Pin a lit probe for each verdict at the door.

**Business reason:** a Studio or MCP author who mistypes a dataset name, or names a measure the dataset lacks, gets a saved view that renders an empty or broken chart. Nothing says why, and the CLI would have refused the same file.

**Reader who acts:** `domain:spec` (`packages/lint`, the reference-integrity suite).

Related: #26719 (PR #26842) adds the sibling `list-view-chart-dataset-foreign-object` in `validateListViewFieldRefs`, which already runs at the view door.

Dedupe: open issues searched for "chart list view unknown dataset publish 200 view door", "validateChartBindings runtimeTypes view" and "chart-dataset-unknown view item": none. Closed #22491 is the missing-`chart`-block case, a different verdict.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
